import pandas as pd,numpy as np,pyarrow.parquet as pq

out=root/"reports/research/510300_equal_production_original_decision_return_description_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()

 p=out/name;assert not p.exists(),"已有对象不覆盖："+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")

proto={"study_id":"510300_EQUAL_PRODUCTION_ORIGINAL_DECISION_RETURN_DESCRIPTION_V1","experiment_id":"E61","registered_at":now(),
 "status":"REGISTERED_ALL_7_FIRST_ORIGINAL_DECISIONS_BEFORE_RETURN_LABEL_SELECTION",
 "parent":P+"/result.json","question":"完整原月份中同生产49.8及其不同公开共同背景，是否已经足以决定后续五日扣费收益方向。",
 "first_decision_rule":"固定原全部1711当前/成熟成员中每个同值统计月idx最小的原决定；须解释显示钟不晚于该原决定。未知时保留该月未知，不向后挑可用/盈利日。",
 "population":"E60完整7同值月份；原142成员身份保留，主比较唯一每月第一原决定，共7，不按收益、评分、类别或已知盈利窗口筛选。",
 "cause_groups":"直接复用E60在标签读取前已保存的明确共同解释/背景/UNKNOWN，原因可并存。2022-08整体PMI回升具体原因未知，不用收益替其贴标签。",
 "fixed_return":"原net_label：下一原合法交易日开盘入、入场后第5个交易日开盘出，原10000份、佣金/最小佣金/滑点报价取整及分红标签保持；仅原标签，不建立新仓位/账户。",
 "price_observation":"决定前5原交易日原收盘价涨跌=close_t/close_t-5−1，含原决定日收盘；仅价格观察、非含分红净账户回报或完整预期吸收。",
 "comparison":"复用原八字段原每日预测/分数、均值对照和actual_net5核原net_label，不重训或改变高分线。",
 "decision":"若原7净标签出现正负两种，拒绝把该同值当历史确定方向的充分条件；无论点值如何都不从7次算概率校准/独立机制/账户夏普，不修改原因或规则救结果。",
 "budgets":{"new_fits":0,"new_return_labels":0,"network_requests":0,"new_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0},
 "sources":[label_path,score_path,P+"/全部7同值月_明确共同原因_不同对象_背景_未知.json",P+"/全部同值原成员_公开原因与决定钟.csv"],
 "post_selection":"同值问题来自旧E52失败，旧历史已被研究，本分析是描述与反例，不是独立验证或候选策略。",
 "first_vintage_authenticated":False,"complete_market_surprise":"UNKNOWN","stock_causal_effect":"NOT_IDENTIFIED","net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,
 "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False}
save("protocol.json",proto)
causes=json.loads((root/P/"全部7同值月_明确共同原因_不同对象_背景_未知.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
members=pd.read_csv(root/P/"全部同值原成员_公开原因与决定钟.csv",encoding="utf-8-sig")
first=members.sort_values("idx").groupby("stat_month",sort=True).first().reset_index()
assert len(members)==142 and len(first)==len(causes)==7
assert first.new_display_clock_predecision.all()
indices=first.idx.astype(int).tolist()
save("原7第一决定标签读取前固定选择.json",{"at":now(),"indices":indices,"selection_basis":"完整原同值母集每月首原决定，不用标签/评分选择","original_months":first.stat_month.tolist(),"all_original_members":142,"cause_json_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/P/"全部7同值月_明确共同原因_不同对象_背景_未知.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
d=pd.read_parquet(root/label_path,columns=["idx","date","decision_time","open","close","exit_idx","net_label","stat_month"])
assert np.array_equal(d.idx.to_numpy(),np.arange(len(d)))
scores=pd.read_csv(root/score_path,encoding="utf-8-sig").set_index("idx")
by={x["stat_month"]:x for x in causes};rows=[]
for rec in first.itertuples(index=False):
 i=int(rec.idx);r=d.iloc[i];c=by[rec.stat_month];e=i+1;x=int(r.exit_idx)
 assert x==e+5 and r.stat_month==rec.stat_month and e<len(d) and x<len(d)
 y=float(r.net_label);assert np.isfinite(y)
 old=scores.loc[i]
 assert abs(y-float(old.actual_net5))<1e-12
 rows.append({"stat_month":rec.stat_month,"production":49.8,"production_change":c["production_change"],"orders":c["orders"],"pmi":c["pmi"],
 "decision_idx":i,"decision_date":pd.Timestamp(r.date).date().isoformat(),"decision_time":str(r.decision_time),
 "interpretation_display_clock":c["display_clock"],"display_clock_predecision":bool(rec.new_display_clock_predecision),
 "entry_date":pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[e]).date().isoformat(),"exit_date":pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[x]).date().isoformat(),"entry_year":int(pd.Timestamp(d.date.iloc[e]).year),
 "original_net5":y,"prior5_original_close_change":float(r.close/d.close.iloc[i-5]-1),
 "original8_prediction":float(old.nonlinear_prediction),"original8_score":float(old.score),"original_same_pool_mean_prediction":float(old.mean_prediction),
 "original_80_and_positive_condition":bool(old.score>=80 and old.nonlinear_prediction>0),
 "joint_factors":"、".join(c["joint"]) if c["joint"] else "UNKNOWN_OVERALL_REASON_CONTEXT_ONLY","specific_production_reason":c["production_reason"],
 "original_cause_scope":c["scope"],"source_url":c["url"],"net_label_matches_original8_daily_actual":True,
 "first_vintage_authenticated":False,"stock_causal_effect":"NOT_IDENTIFIED"})
frame=pd.DataFrame(rows)
frame.to_csv(out/"全部7第一原决定_原原因_价格反应_原净标签_原分数.csv",index=False,encoding="utf-8-sig")
positive=int((frame.original_net5>0).sum());negative=int((frame.original_net5<0).sum());zero=int((frame.original_net5==0).sum())
mixed=positive>0 and negative>0
result={"study_id":proto["study_id"],"experiment_id":"E61","completed_at":now(),
 "status":"COMPLETED_ORIGINAL_EQUAL_LEVEL_NOT_SUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_RETURN_DIRECTION_COUNTEREXAMPLES" if mixed else "COMPLETED_7_ORIGINAL_LABELS_SAME_SIGN_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY_NO_STRATEGY_VALIDATION",
 "all_original_equal_months":frame.stat_month.tolist(),"fixed_first_original_decisions":7,"all_original_equal_members_kept":142,
 "old_labels_reused":7,"positive_net_labels":positive,"negative_net_labels":negative,"zero_net_labels":zero,
 "arithmetic_net5_mean":float(frame.original_net5.mean()),"positive_fraction_description_only":float(positive/len(frame)),
 "raw_original_endpoint_label_range":[float(frame.original_net5.min()),float(frame.original_net5.max())],
 "prior5_price_change_range":[float(frame.prior5_original_close_change.min()),float(frame.prior5_original_close_change.max())],
 "original8_high_positive_scores":int(frame.original_80_and_positive_condition.sum()),
 "natural_entry_year_observation_counts":{str(int(k)):int(v) for k,v in frame.groupby("entry_year").size().items()},
 "all_original8_actual_labels_match":True,"same_level_not_sufficient_if_mixed":mixed,"all_cause_objects_preserved":True,
 "complete_market_surprise":"UNKNOWN","stock_causal_effect":"NOT_IDENTIFIED","first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,
 "new_fits":0,"new_labels":0,"new_accounts":0,"network_requests":0,"source_code_edits":0,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,
 "account_admission":"NOT_A_STRATEGY_OR_ACCOUNT_TEST","original_E51_E56_rejections_preserved":True,"root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0,"live_process":False,
 "next":"只有实质完整而不同的原因量或官方明确表达信息才另登记来源/用途；七同值案例不改成天气/春节交易分类，不改模型/期限/线或追涨幅窗口。"}
save("result.json",result)
md=["# 相同生产49.8：七个原决定的净收益与反例","",
 "E61在读取收益前固定完整七月、各月原第一决定、原五日扣费标签和原八字段评分。全部原142同值成员身份保留，七代表点不是从盈利/原因类别/分数挑选。原历史已见，不宣称独立检验。",
 "", "| 原月 | 生产月变 | 原决定 | 原下一入场→五日退出 | 决定前5日原价 | 原净五日 | 原八分数 |","|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|"]
for r in rows:md.append(f"| {r['stat_month']} | {r['production_change']:+.1f} | {r['decision_date']} | {r['entry_date']}→{r['exit_date']} | {r['prior5_original_close_change']:.4%} | {r['original_net5']:.4%} | {r['original8_score']:.2f} |")
md+=["",f"原七净标签正{positive}/负{negative}/零{zero}，算术平均{result['arithmetic_net5_mean']:.6%}；这些是原10000份同标签的描述，不是完整账户CAGR/夏普。按原入场年观察次数为{result['natural_entry_year_observation_counts']}，没有年五策略支持。",
 "", "正负两种原结果若同时出现，足以否定“生产49.8保证后续五日确定方向”这一充分条件；仍不能判定所有宏观信息或不同联合原因无用。官方说明作用于不同对象，原因与原价格反应可并存；完整市场预期差和股票因果未知，不能据结果补分类、反号或形成七次策略。",
 "", "没有重新拟合、重算训练标签、新账户、网络或源码修改。原八actual与七net_label逐一一致，原决定/入退出顺序正确，显示钟先于原决定但历史首版未认证。当前净夏普NOT_COMPUTED、完整目标未达。",
 "", "直接证据是protocol.json、原7第一决定标签读取前固定选择.json、全部7第一原决定_原原因_价格反应_原净标签_原分数.csv和result.json。"]
(out/"同49点8的原七收益与信息反例.md").write_text("\n".join(md)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"summary":result,"seven":rows},ensure_ascii=False))
